title: Notchset base
description: A new project set up for Notchset: the theme and its fonts, the foundation every item needs, and the @notchset and @notchset-pro registries in components.json.
docs: Notchset is set up. Add any free item with @notchset/<id>; Pro items install with @notchset-pro/<id> once NOTCHSET_TOKEN is in .env.local (https://notchset.dev/docs/pro).
